words.example: The hotel can accommodate up to 500 guests.
words.exampleZh: 这家旅馆最多可容纳 500 位客人。
words.mnemonic: ac-（加强）+ com-（共同）+ mod（方式/模式）+ -ate → 让大家在同一个方式下 → 容纳；适应。名词 accommodation（住宿）。

extraExamples.en: The eye can accommodate to different light levels.
extraExamples.zh: 眼睛能适应不同的光线。

extraExamples.en: I will accommodate my plans to yours.
extraExamples.zh: 我会调整计划以配合你的。

words.example: The medicine helped alleviate the patient’s pain.
words.exampleZh: 这种药帮助减轻了病人的疼痛。
words.mnemonic: al-（向）+ levi（轻，同 lever 杠杆）+ -ate → 使变轻 → 减轻。同根：levity（轻浮）、relevant（相关的，本不重要的事"举"起来了）。

extraExamples.en: The policy aims to alleviate traffic congestion.
extraExamples.zh: 该政策旨在缓解交通拥堵。

extraExamples.en: Nothing could alleviate her disappointment.
extraExamples.zh: 没有什么能减轻她的失望。

words.definition: 模棱两可的，含糊不清的
words.example: His reply was ambiguous and confused everyone.
words.exampleZh: 他的回答模棱两可，让大家都糊涂了。
words.mnemonic: ambi-（两个，同 ambition 雄心=两头跑）+ ag（驱动）+ -uous → 两种方向都能驱动 → 模棱两可。名词 ambiguity。

extraExamples.en: The wording of the contract is ambiguous.
He gave an ambiguous smile.
extraExamples.zh: 他露出一个意味深长的微笑。

words.example: We anticipate that sales will rise next quarter.
words.exampleZh: 我们预计下季度销售额会上升。
words.mnemonic: anti-（前）+ cip（拿，同 capture 抓）+ -ate → 提前拿到消息 → 预期。名词 anticipation（预期）。

extraExamples.en: We anticipated the storm and closed early.
extraExamples.zh: 我们预料到暴风雨，提前关门了。

extraExamples.en: Try to anticipate the customer’s needs.
extraExamples.zh: 要尽量预判客户的需求。

words.example: She felt some apprehension before the exam.
words.exampleZh: 考试前她感到有些忧虑。
words.mnemonic: ap-（向）+ prehen（抓，同 prison 监狱）+ -sion → 心被抓住了 → 忧虑。形容词 apprehensive（忧虑的）。

extraExamples.en: He watched the door in apprehension.
The matter is beyond my apprehension.

words.example: He is able to articulate his ideas clearly.
words.exampleZh: 他能清楚表达自己的想法。
words.mnemonic: articul（关节，同 article 关节相连）+ -ate → 像关节一样一节一节连起来 → 表达清晰。名词 articulation。

extraExamples.en: She is articulate and confident.
He articulated his opposition to the plan.
extraExamples.zh: 他明确表达了对该计划的反对。

words.example: The museum displays authentic historical documents.
words.exampleZh: 博物馆展出真实的历史文献。
words.mnemonic: authent（原作）+ -ic → 原作的 → 真迹的、正宗的。反义词 fake（假的）。名词 authenticity（真实性）。

extraExamples.en: Is that an authentic Picasso?
The hotel offers an authentic local experience.
extraExamples.zh: 这家酒店提供地道的本地体验。

words.example: The new policy will boost economic growth.
words.exampleZh: 新政策将促进经济增长。
words.mnemonic: 拟声词："噗"一声往上推。联想：boo（嘘）+ st → 把人嘘起来。

extraExamples.en: Winning the prize boosted her confidence.
The tax cut gave a boost to the economy.

words.example: She gave a coherent summary of the meeting.
words.exampleZh: 她做了条理清晰的会议总结。
words.mnemonic: co-（一起）+ her（粘，同 adhere 粘着）+ -ent → 粘在一起 → 连贯的。名词 coherence（连贯性）。

extraExamples.en: The analysis is clear and coherent.
He was too tired to give a coherent reply.
extraExamples.zh: 他太累了，回答都说不连贯。

words.example: The two teams will collaborate on the project.
words.exampleZh: 两个团队将在该项目上合作。
words.mnemonic: col-（一起）+ labor（劳动）+ -ate → 一起劳动 → 合作。名词 collaboration；合作者 collaborator。

extraExamples.en: The two companies collaborated on the design.
extraExamples.zh: 两家公司在设计上合作。

extraExamples.en: She collaborated with the police on the enquiry.
extraExamples.zh: 她在调查中与警方合作。

words.example: Nothing can compensate for the loss of time.
words.exampleZh: 任何东西都无法弥补时间上的损失。
words.mnemonic: com-（一起）+ pens（称量，同 pension 养老金=称量出来的钱）+ -ate → 称量补平 → 补偿。名词 compensation。

extraExamples.en: The company compensated him for the injury.
extraExamples.zh: 公司因他受伤给予赔偿。

extraExamples.en: Her enthusiasm compensates for her lack of experience.
extraExamples.zh: 她的热情弥补了经验的不足。

words.example: The report gives a comprehensive overview.
words.exampleZh: 这份报告给出了全面的概述。
words.mnemonic: com-（全部）+ prehens（抓，同 prison 抓起来）+ -ive → 全部抓住 → 全面的。同根：comprehend（理解=全部抓住）。

extraExamples.en: We need a comprehensive plan.
extraExamples.zh: 我们需要一个全面的计划。

extraExamples.en: The book provides a comprehensive guide.
extraExamples.zh: 这本书提供了详尽指南。

words.example: Students must conform to the school rules.
words.exampleZh: 学生必须遵守学校规则。
words.mnemonic: con-（共同）+ form（形状）→ 共同一个形状 → 一致、遵守。名词 conformity（从众）。

extraExamples.en: The building conforms to safety standards.
extraExamples.zh: 这座建筑符合安全标准。

extraExamples.en: He refused to conform to social expectations.

words.example: It rained for three consecutive days.
words.exampleZh: 一连下了三天雨。
words.mnemonic: con-（一起）+ secut（跟随，同 sequence 顺序）+ -ive → 一个跟一个 → 连续的。

extraExamples.en: She was voted MVP for the third consecutive year.
extraExamples.zh: 她连续第三年当选最有价值球员。

extraExamples.en: The team won five consecutive games.

words.example: The company moved to consolidate its market position.
words.exampleZh: 公司着手巩固其市场地位。
words.mnemonic: con-（共同）+ solid（坚固）+ -ate → 使坚固 → 巩固。名词 consolidation。

extraExamples.en: She took a break to consolidate her learning.
extraExamples.zh: 她休息一下以巩固所学。

extraExamples.en: The two banks consolidated last year.

words.example: She contemplated changing her career.
words.exampleZh: 她考虑更换职业。
words.mnemonic: con-（一起）+ templ（庙/神殿，同 temple）+ -ate → 在神殿里凝神 → 沉思。名词 contemplation。

extraExamples.en: He sat there, contemplating his options.
extraExamples.zh: 他坐在那里，思考自己的选择。

extraExamples.en: I have never contemplated suicide.
extraExamples.zh: 我从未有过自杀的念头。

words.example: The new law is highly controversial.
words.exampleZh: 这部新法律极具争议。
words.mnemonic: contro-（相反）+ vers（转，同 reverse 反转）+ -ial → 反着转 → 争议。名词 controversy。

extraExamples.en: Abortion is a controversial topic.
extraExamples.zh: 堕胎是个有争议的话题。

extraExamples.en: He wrote a controversial book on education.
extraExamples.zh: 他写了一本有争议的教育书。

words.example: The selection is based on strict criteria.
words.exampleZh: 选拔基于严格的标准。
words.mnemonic: 单数 criterion，复数 criteria（少见的 -on→-a 复数，同 phenomenon→phenomena）。口诀："标准 criterion，复数 criteria"。

extraExamples.en: What are the criteria for admission?
The design fails to meet our criteria.
extraExamples.zh: 该设计不符合我们的标准。

words.definition: 培养，栽培；发展（关系、习惯）
words.example: Reading helps cultivate independent thinking.
words.exampleZh: 阅读有助于培养独立思考。
words.mnemonic: cultiv（耕，同 culture 文化=农耕出来的）+ -ate → 耕作 → 培养。名词 cultivation。

extraExamples.en: They cultivate rice in the south.
You should cultivate a positive attitude.

words.example: She dedicated herself to scientific research.
words.exampleZh: 她献身于科学研究。
words.mnemonic: de-（加强）+ dic（说/宣告，同 dictionary）+ -ate → 宣告奉献 →  dedicate。形容词 dedicated（专注的）。

extraExamples.en: He dedicated his life to helping the poor.
The book is dedicated to my wife.
extraExamples.zh: 谨以此书献给我的妻子。

words.example: A vitamin deficiency can cause fatigue.
words.exampleZh: 缺乏维生素会导致疲劳。
words.mnemonic: de-（向下）+ fic（做，同 efficient）+ -iency → 做得不够 → 不足。同根：deficient（不足的）。

extraExamples.en: The doctor found a deficiency in iron.
They tried to compensate for their deficiencies.

words.example: Plastic waste degrades very slowly in nature.
words.exampleZh: 塑料垃圾在自然界降解得非常缓慢。
words.mnemonic: de-（向下）+ grade（等级）→ 等级下降 → 退化、贬低。名词 degradation。

extraExamples.en: The material degrades over time.
extraExamples.zh: 这种材料会随时间降解。

extraExamples.en: You degrade yourself by lying.

words.example: It was a deliberate attempt to mislead the public.
words.exampleZh: 这是故意误导公众的企图。
words.mnemonic: de-（完全）+ liber（天平/平衡，同 liberate 称量释放）+ -ate → 反复称量 → 故意的、深思熟虑的。

extraExamples.en: Her answer was slow and deliberate.
We need to deliberate before deciding.
extraExamples.zh: 我们决定前要慎重考虑。

words.example: The term can denote more than one meaning.
words.exampleZh: 该词可以表示不止一种含义。
words.mnemonic: de-（下）+ not（标记，同 note）+ -e → 做标记 → 表示。反义词 connote（隐含=共同标记）。

extraExamples.en: A red line on the map denotes a railway.
extraExamples.zh: 地图上的红线表示铁路。

extraExamples.en: The symbol denotes danger.

words.example: The noise deprived us of a good night’s sleep.
words.exampleZh: 噪音让我们无法好好睡一觉。
words.mnemonic: de-（离开）+ priv（私有，同 private 私人）→ 从私人那里夺走 → 剥夺。名词 deprivation。

extraExamples.en: They were deprived of education.
extraExamples.zh: 他们被剥夺了受教育的权利。

extraExamples.en: The court deprived him of his parental rights.
extraExamples.zh: 法院剥夺了他的抚养权。

words.example: Many English words derive from Latin.
words.exampleZh: 许多英语单词源自拉丁语。
words.mnemonic: de-（从）+ rive（河流，同 river）→ 从河里引出 → 源自。名词 derivation；衍生词 derivative。

extraExamples.en: He derives great satisfaction from his work.
extraExamples.zh: 他从工作中获得极大满足。

extraExamples.en: The word derives from Greek.

words.example: The patient’s condition began to deteriorate.
words.exampleZh: 病人的病情开始恶化。
words.mnemonic: deterior（更坏，同 bad 比较级 deterior）+ -ate → 变得更坏。名词 deterioration。

extraExamples.en: His eyesight deteriorated with age.
The weather deteriorated overnight.

words.example: The pain gradually diminished.
words.exampleZh: 疼痛逐渐减轻了。
words.mnemonic: di-（离开）+ min（小，同 minimum）+ -ish → 变小 → 减少。

extraExamples.en: The pain slowly diminished.
Time will not diminish our friendship.
extraExamples.zh: 时间不会冲淡我们的友谊。

words.example: There is a discrepancy between the two reports.
words.exampleZh: 两份报告之间存在差异。

phrases.en: a discrepancy between A and B

words.mnemonic: dis-（分开）+ crep（破裂声，同 crack）+ -ancy → 声音对不上 → 不一致。

extraExamples.en: We noticed a discrepancy in the accounts.
extraExamples.zh: 我们注意到账目有出入。

extraExamples.en: The discrepancy must be explained.
extraExamples.zh: 这个矛盾必须解释清楚。

words.example: The city has a diverse population.
words.exampleZh: 这座城市人口多样化。
words.mnemonic: di-（分开）+ vers（转，同 reverse 反转）+ -e → 转开 → 多样的。名词 diversity（多样性）。

extraExamples.en: The college has a diverse student body.
extraExamples.zh: 这所大学学生背景多元。

extraExamples.en: People from diverse backgrounds live here.
extraExamples.zh: 不同背景的人住在这里。

words.example: A few large firms dominate the market.
words.exampleZh: 少数大公司主导着市场。
words.mnemonic: domin（主人，同 dome 圆屋顶=主人家）+ -ate → 当主人 → 支配。名词 dominance；形容词 dominant（占主导的）。

extraExamples.en: The team has dominated the league for years.
extraExamples.zh: 这支球队多年称霸联赛。

extraExamples.en: He tends to dominate the conversation.

words.example: These shoes are durable and comfortable.
words.exampleZh: 这双鞋结实又舒适。
words.mnemonic: dur（持续，同 during 在……期间）+ -able（能……的）→ 能持续的 → 耐用的。名词 duration（持续时间）。

extraExamples.en: The shells are made of durable plastic.
We need a durable solution to the problem.
extraExamples.zh: 我们需要一个持久的解决方案。

words.example: Only citizens are eligible to vote.
words.exampleZh: 只有公民才有资格投票。
words.mnemonic: e-（出）+ lig（选，同 elect 选举）+ -ible → 能被选出来的 → 合格的。反义词 ineligible。

extraExamples.en: Only full-time employees are eligible for the bonus.
extraExamples.zh: 只有全职员工才有资格拿奖金。

extraExamples.en: You must be 18 or over to be eligible.
extraExamples.zh: 你必须年满18岁才有资格。

words.example: New problems emerged during the discussion.
words.exampleZh: 讨论中出现了一些新问题。
words.mnemonic: e-（出）+ merg（浸，同 merge 合并=浸到一起）→ 从水里浮出来 → 浮现。名词 emergence；形容词 emergent（新兴的）。

extraExamples.en: The sun emerged from behind the clouds.
She emerged as a leading figure in science.
extraExamples.zh: 她崛起为科学界领军人物。

words.example: Exercise can enhance your overall health.
words.exampleZh: 锻炼能改善你的整体健康。
words.mnemonic: en-（使）+ hance（高，同 ascend 上升）→ 使变高 → 提高。名词 enhancement。

extraExamples.en: The sauce enhances the flavor of the dish.
extraExamples.zh: 这种酱汁提升了菜品的风味。

extraExamples.en: Technology has enhanced our lives.
extraExamples.zh: 科技改善了我们的生活。

words.example: The project required an enormous amount of effort.
words.exampleZh: 这个项目需要投入巨大的精力。
words.mnemonic: e-（出）+ norm（标准，同 normal 正常）+ -ous → 超出正常标准 → 巨大的。副词 enormously。

extraExamples.en: The report caused an enormous stir.
extraExamples.zh: 这份报告引起了巨大轰动。

extraExamples.en: They spent an enormous sum on the wedding.
extraExamples.zh: 他们在婚礼上花了一大笔钱。

words.example: The song evoked fond memories of childhood.
words.exampleZh: 这首歌唤起对童年的美好回忆。
words.mnemonic: e-（出）+ vok（喊，同 voice 声音）→ 喊出来 → 唤起。名词 evocation。

extraExamples.en: The place evoked happy memories.
extraExamples.zh: 这个地方唤起了美好回忆。

extraExamples.en: His words evoked a strong response.
extraExamples.zh: 他的话引起了强烈反响。

words.example: He tends to exaggerate his achievements.
words.exampleZh: 他总爱夸大自己的成就。
words.mnemonic: ex-（出）+ agger（堆，同 aggregate 聚集）+ -ate → 堆得高出实际 → 夸大。名词 exaggeration。

extraExamples.en: Don’t exaggerate the problem.
Maybe I exaggerated a little.

words.example: The instructions are explicit and easy to follow.
words.exampleZh: 说明明确易懂。
words.mnemonic: ex-（出）+ plic（折叠，同 imply 折在里面=暗示）+ -it → 折在外面 = 明确说出。反义词 implicit（隐含的）。

extraExamples.en: She was quite explicit about what she wanted.
extraExamples.zh: 她对想要什么说得很明白。

extraExamples.en: He gave explicit instructions not to enter.

words.example: The new system facilitates faster data sharing.
words.exampleZh: 新系统使数据共享更快捷。
words.mnemonic: facil（容易，同 facility 设施）+ -itate → 使容易 → 促进。注意：主语是事物不是人，不能说 I facilitate sb.。

extraExamples.en: The internet facilitates long-distance learning.
extraExamples.zh: 互联网便利了远程学习。

extraExamples.en: Friendly chats facilitate cooperation.

words.example: We need to decide whether the plan is feasible.
words.exampleZh: 我们需要判断这个计划是否可行。
words.mnemonic: feas（做，同 feat 功绩）+ -ible（能……的）→ 能做到的 → 可行的。名词 feasibility（可行性）。

extraExamples.en: Is it feasible to finish by Friday?
No feasible solution has been found.
extraExamples.zh: 还没找到可行的解决方案。

words.example: Prices fluctuate depending on supply and demand.
words.exampleZh: 价格随供需关系而波动。
words.mnemonic: flu（流，同 fluid 流体）+ ctu + -ate → 像水流一样起伏 → 波动。名词 fluctuation。

extraExamples.en: His mood fluctuates wildly.
The temperature fluctuates by 10 degrees.

words.definition: 强大的，令人敬畏的，难对付的
words.example: They faced a formidable challenge.
words.exampleZh: 他们面临艰巨的挑战。
words.mnemonic: formid（恐惧，同 fear 怕）+ -able → 让人害怕的 → 强大的、难对付的。

extraExamples.en: She has a formidable intellect.
The team is a formidable opponent.
extraExamples.zh: 这支队伍是强劲的对手。

words.example: The program aims to foster creativity in children.
words.exampleZh: 该项目旨在培养儿童的创造力。
words.mnemonic: fost（饲养/养育）+ -er → 养育 → 培养。双义：养孩子 = foster a child；培养感情 = foster friendship。

extraExamples.en: The foster parents treated him as their own.
Good meals foster good health.

words.example: The economy remains fragile after the crisis.
words.exampleZh: 危机过后经济仍然脆弱。

phrases.zh: 虚弱的健康/脆弱的自尊

words.mnemonic: frag（打碎，同 fraction 碎片）+ -ile → 容易打碎的 → 脆弱的。名词 fragility。

extraExamples.en: Be careful — the vase is fragile.
The political situation remains fragile.

words.example: Freedom of speech is a fundamental right.
words.exampleZh: 言论自由是一项基本权利。
words.mnemonic: fund（基础，同 foundation 地基）+ -ment + -al → 地基的 → 根本的。

extraExamples.en: Honesty is fundamental to a good relationship.
extraExamples.zh: 诚实是良好关系的基石。

extraExamples.en: There is a fundamental difference between them.

words.example: Bad weather hampered the rescue efforts.
words.exampleZh: 恶劣天气阻碍了救援工作。
words.mnemonic: 原指"提篮"，引申为"被篮子绊住"→ 妨碍。比 hinder 更正式，常用于被动 be hampered by。

extraExamples.en: The project was hampered by lack of funds.
Rescue efforts were hampered by fog.

words.example: Lack of funding hindered the research.
words.exampleZh: 资金不足阻碍了这项研究。
words.mnemonic: hind（后面，同 behind）+ -er → 从后面拽 → 阻碍。名词 hindrance（障碍）。

extraExamples.en: Don’t let me hinder you.
Overcrowding hinders learning.

words.example: The results support our original hypothesis.
words.exampleZh: 结果支持我们最初的假设。
words.mnemonic: hypo-（在下，同 hypodermic 皮下）+ thesis（放置）→ 放在下面待证的命题 → 假设。复数 hypotheses。

extraExamples.en: The experiment confirmed the hypothesis.
We need to test this hypothesis further.
extraExamples.zh: 我们需要进一步验证这个假设。

words.example: The two copies are identical in content.
words.exampleZh: 两份副本内容完全相同。
words.mnemonic: ident（相同，同 identify 识别=看成同一个）+ -ical → 同一的 → 完全相同的。

extraExamples.en: Your shirt is identical to mine.
extraExamples.zh: 你的衬衫和我的一模一样。

extraExamples.en: The tests produced identical results.

words.example: The company will implement the new policy soon.
words.exampleZh: 公司很快将实施新政策。
words.mnemonic: im-（进入）+ ple（填满，同 complete）+ -ment → 把计划填满落地 → 实施。名词 implementation。

extraExamples.en: The changes will be implemented next month.
We need someone to implement the ideas.
extraExamples.zh: 我们需要有人把想法落地。

words.example: The research has important implications for policy.
words.exampleZh: 这项研究对政策有重要影响。
words.mnemonic: im-（里面）+ plic（折叠，同 explicit 折外面）→ 折在里面的意思 → 暗示、含义。动词 imply（暗示）。

extraExamples.en: The theory has far-reaching implications.
He smiled, and by implication agreed.

words.example: Bonuses provide an incentive for hard work.
words.exampleZh: 奖金是对努力工作的激励。
words.mnemonic: in-（进入）+ cent（唱，同 chant）+ -ive → 唱着歌让人干 → 激励。

extraExamples.en: There is no incentive to save water.
The bonus is a strong incentive.

words.example: Change is inevitable in a fast-moving industry.
words.exampleZh: 在快速发展的行业里，变化是不可避免的。
words.mnemonic: in-（不）+ evit（避免，同 evitable）+ -able → 不能避免的。名词 inevitability。

extraExamples.en: Such a result was inevitable.
Death is inevitable.

words.example: Fear can inhibit people from speaking up.
words.exampleZh: 恐惧会让人不敢开口说话。
words.mnemonic: in-（里面）+ hibit（拿住，同 exhibit 拿出来=展览）→ 拿在里面 → 抑制。名词 inhibition；形容词 inhibitory。

extraExamples.en: Splendid churches inhibit the spread of weeds.
Shyness inhibited her from raising her hand.

words.example: The school helps newcomers integrate into the community.
words.exampleZh: 学校帮助新来者融入社区。
words.mnemonic: integr（完整，同 integer 整数）+ -ate → 使完整 → 整合。名词 integration；形容词 integrated（综合的）。

extraExamples.en: We need to integrate theory with practice.
extraExamples.zh: 我们需要理论联系实际。

extraExamples.en: Immigrants find it hard to integrate.

words.example: She took an intensive English course before the exam.
words.exampleZh: 考试前她参加了强化的英语课程。
words.mnemonic: in-（加强）+ tens（伸展，同 tension 张力）+ -ive → 拉伸得很紧 → 密集的。对比 extensive（广泛的）。

extraExamples.en: He spent the summer on intensive study.
extraExamples.zh: 他整个夏天都在强化学习。

extraExamples.en: The hospital provides intensive care.
extraExamples.zh: 这家医院提供重症监护。

words.example: They have a legitimate claim to the property.
words.exampleZh: 他们对这笔财产有合法的要求权。
words.mnemonic: leg（法律，同 legal）+ -itim + -ate → 合法的。动词 legitimize（使合法化）。

extraExamples.en: She had a legitimate reason for being late.
Is his business legitimate?

words.example: A microscope can magnify tiny objects.
words.exampleZh: 显微镜能放大微小的物体。
words.mnemonic: magn（大，同 magnificent 壮观）+ -ify（使）→ 使变大 → 放大。名词 magnification。

extraExamples.en: The microscope magnifies bacteria 1000 times.
Don’t magnify your difficulties.

words.example: Advertisers often manipulate consumer desires.
words.exampleZh: 广告商常常操纵消费者的欲望。
words.mnemonic: mani（手，同 manual 手动）+ pul（拉，同 pull）+ -ate → 用手拉 → 操纵。名词 manipulation。

extraExamples.en: He manipulated the controls with skill.
extraExamples.zh: 他熟练地操作控制装置。

extraExamples.en: She manipulated him into giving her money.

words.example: New measures were taken to mitigate the damage.
words.exampleZh: 已采取新措施以减轻损失。
words.mnemonic: miti（温和，同 mild 温和）+ -gate → 使变温和 → 缓解。名词 mitigation。

extraExamples.en: Steps were taken to mitigate the problem.
Nothing could mitigate the disaster.
extraExamples.zh: 什么都无法减轻这场灾难。

words.example: He rejected the notion that success is purely luck.
words.exampleZh: 他否定了"成功纯粹靠运气"这种观念。
words.mnemonic: not（知道，同 know）+ -ion → 知道的东西 → 概念、观念。

extraExamples.en: I have no notion of what he means.
extraExamples.zh: 我完全不懂他什么意思。

extraExamples.en: She had some odd notions about money.
extraExamples.zh: 她对金钱有些奇怪的观念。

words.example: Old methods soon become obsolete in technology.
words.exampleZh: 在技术领域，旧方法很快过时。
words.mnemonic: ob-（对抗）+ sole（习惯，同 custom）+ -ete → 与旧习惯对抗 → 过时的。

extraExamples.en: Typewriters are now obsolete.
The equipment is obsolete but still works.

words.example: She remains optimistic about the future.
words.exampleZh: 她对未来仍持乐观态度。
words.mnemonic: optim（最好，同 optimum 最优）+ -istic → 往最好想 → 乐观的。名词 optimism；反义 pessimistic。

extraExamples.en: He is optimistic that we will succeed.
extraExamples.zh: 他乐观地认为我们会成功。

extraExamples.en: Despite the rain, she stayed optimistic.

words.example: The outcome of the election surprised many.
words.exampleZh: 选举结果让许多人惊讶。
words.mnemonic: out（出来）+ come（来）→ 出来的东西 → 结果。

extraExamples.en: We are waiting for the outcome.
The outcome was far from expected.

words.example: She was overwhelmed by the amount of work.
words.exampleZh: 她被繁重的工作压得不知所措。
words.mnemonic: over-（过度）+ whelm（淹没）→ 完全淹没 → 压倒。形容词 overwhelming（压倒性的）。

extraExamples.en: The smell overwhelmed her.
She was overwhelmed with joy.

words.example: Reading broadens your perspective on life.
words.exampleZh: 阅读能拓宽你对生活的看法。
words.mnemonic: per-（穿过）+ spect（看，同 inspect 检查）+ -ive → 看穿 → 视角。

extraExamples.en: Try to see it from my perspective.
Travel gives you a new perspective.

words.example: He gave a plausible explanation for the delay.
words.exampleZh: 他对延误给出了貌似合理的解释。
words.mnemonic: plaus（鼓掌，同 applause）+ -ible → 能让人鼓掌的 → 貌似可信的。注意：常暗示"其实未必对"。

extraExamples.en: That is a plausible argument.
extraExamples.zh: 那是个貌似有理的论点。

extraExamples.en: Her story sounds plausible.
extraExamples.zh: 她的说法听起来像真的。

words.example: We took precautions to avoid accidents.
words.exampleZh: 我们采取了预防措施以避免事故。
words.mnemonic: pre-（提前）+ caution（小心）→ 提前小心 → 预防措施。

extraExamples.en: Wear a helmet as a precaution.
Precautions were taken against fire.

words.example: The preliminary results look promising.
words.exampleZh: 初步结果看起来很有希望。
words.mnemonic: pre-（提前）+ limin（门槛，同 eliminate 挡在门外）+ -ary → 还在门槛外 → 初步的。

extraExamples.en: After a preliminary discussion, we agreed.
extraExamples.zh: 初步讨论后我们达成一致。

extraExamples.en: She got through the preliminary round.

words.example: She played a prominent role in the campaign.
words.exampleZh: 她在活动中发挥了突出作用。
words.mnemonic: pro-（向前）+ min（突出，同 eminent 杰出）+ -ent → 向前凸出 → 突出的。名词 prominence。

extraExamples.en: The church is a prominent landmark.
extraExamples.zh: 这座教堂是显眼的地标。

extraExamples.en: He played a prominent part in the project.

words.example: Economic prosperity benefits the whole society.
words.exampleZh: 经济繁荣惠及整个社会。
words.mnemonic: pro-（向前）+ sper（希望，同 desperate 没有希望）+ -ity → 有希望 → 繁荣。形容词 prosperous。

extraExamples.en: The country enjoyed years of prosperity.
extraExamples.zh: 这个国家经历了多年繁荣。

extraExamples.en: Peace brings prosperity.

words.example: Try to make a rational decision rather than an emotional one.
words.exampleZh: 尽量做出理性而非情绪化的决定。
words.mnemonic: rat（计算，同 rate 比率）+ -ion + -al → 会算账的 → 理性的。反义 irrational。

extraExamples.en: There must be a rational explanation.
Let’s be rational about this.

words.definition: 有韧性的，能迅速恢复的
words.example: Children are often more resilient than adults think.
words.exampleZh: 孩子往往比成人想象中更有韧性。
words.mnemonic: re-（回）#+ sali（跳，同 salient 跳出来的）+ -ent → 跳回来 → 有弹性的。名词 resilience。

extraExamples.en: The human body is remarkably resilient.
She is resilient in the face of hardship.

words.example: He struggled to restrain his anger.
words.exampleZh: 他努力克制住自己的怒气。
words.mnemonic: re-（回）+ strain（拉紧，同 strain 拉力）→ 往回拉紧 → 抑制。名词 restraint。

extraExamples.en: She could not restrain her tears.
The police restrained the crowd.

words.example: The survey revealed surprising findings.
words.exampleZh: 调查揭示了令人意外的发现。
words.mnemonic: re-（相反）+ veal（面纱，同 veil 面纱）→ 揭面纱 → 揭示。名词 revelation。

extraExamples.en: The curtain rose to reveal a empty stage.
extraExamples.zh: 幕布升起，舞台空无一人。

extraExamples.en: He revealed his plans to us.

words.example: The data was collected through rigorous testing.
words.exampleZh: 数据是通过严谨的测试收集的。
words.mnemonic: rig（硬，同 rigid 僵硬）+ -orous → 硬邦邦的 → 严格的。名词 rigor。

extraExamples.en: The report is based on rigorous research.
Students face rigorous exams.
extraExamples.zh: 学生要面对严格的考试。

words.example: The proposal came under close scrutiny.
words.exampleZh: 该提案受到严密审查。
words.mnemonic: scrut（检查，同 scrutinize）+ -iny → 审查。动词 scrutinize。

extraExamples.en: The policy is under public scrutiny.
Her argument doesn’t stand up to scrutiny.

words.example: The two events happened simultaneously.
words.exampleZh: 两件事同时发生。
words.mnemonic: simul（相同，同 similar 相似）+ -taneous + -ly → 同一时间地。形容词 simultaneous。

extraExamples.en: The two guns fired simultaneously.
She translated simultaneously for the CEO.

words.example: Many scientists remain skeptical of the claim.
words.exampleZh: 许多科学家对这一说法仍持怀疑态度。
words.mnemonic: skept（思考，同 scope 看）+ -ical → 看问题爱思考 → 怀疑的。名词 skepticism。

extraExamples.en: I’m skeptical about his chances.
She gave him a skeptical look.

words.example: The lab uses sophisticated equipment.
words.exampleZh: 实验室使用精密设备。
words.mnemonic: sophist（智者）+ -icated → 老于世故的 → 老练的；引申为设备"复杂精密"。

extraExamples.en: She is a sophisticated woman.
extraExamples.zh: 她是个老练世故的女人。

extraExamples.en: The system is highly sophisticated.

words.example: The audience burst into spontaneous applause.
words.exampleZh: 观众爆发出自发的掌声。
words.mnemonic: spont（自愿，同 sponsor 发起人）+ -aneous → 自愿的 → 自发的。

extraExamples.en: The offer was quite spontaneous.
He made a spontaneous decision.

words.definition: 停滞的，不发展的；不流动的
words.example: The economy has been stagnant for years.
words.exampleZh: 经济多年来一直停滞不前。
words.mnemonic: stagn（站，同 stand）+ -ant → 站着不动 → 停滞。动词 stagnate。

extraExamples.en: Stagnant water breeds mosquitoes.
The company became stagnant.

words.example: The lecture stimulated lively discussion.
words.exampleZh: 讲座引发了热烈的讨论。
words.mnemonic: stimul（刺，同 sting 刺）+ -ate → 用刺戳 → 刺激。名词 stimulus（复数 stimuli）。

extraExamples.en: Praise stimulates children to learn.
The exhibition stimulated great interest.

words.example: The project requires substantial investment.
words.exampleZh: 该项目需要大量投资。
words.mnemonic: sub-（下）+ stant（站，同 stand）+ -ial → 站在下面撑住的 → 实质的、大量的。

extraExamples.en: They made substantial progress.
The house is a substantial building.
extraExamples.zh: 这房子是座坚固的建筑。

words.example: We have sufficient evidence to prove it.
words.exampleZh: 我们有充分的证据证明这一点。
words.mnemonic: suf-（下面）+ fic（做，同 effect）+ -ient → 做得够 → 充足的。反义 insufficient。

extraExamples.en: Do we have sufficient food?
One example is sufficient.

words.example: The soil can sustain only limited crops.
words.exampleZh: 这片土壤只能供养有限的作物。
words.mnemonic: sus-（下面）+ tain（握，同 maintain 保持）→ 在下面撑住 → 维持。形容词 sustainable（可持续的）。

extraExamples.en: She could not sustain the effort.
The shelves are sustained by steel.

words.definition: 试探性的，暂时的，不确定的
words.example: We have made a tentative plan for next month.
words.exampleZh: 我们为下个月制定了一个暂定的计划。
words.mnemonic: tent（尝试，同 attempt 尝试）+ -ative → 试着做的 → 试探性的。

extraExamples.en: We reached a tentative agreement.
She gave a tentative smile.

words.example: The virus can transmit from person to person.
words.exampleZh: 这种病毒可以在人与人之间传播。
words.mnemonic: trans-（跨越）+ mit（送，同 mission 送出去=使命）→ 送过去 → 传输。名词 transmission。

extraExamples.en: The program is transmitted live.
Birds transmit the virus.

words.example: The city has undergone rapid change.
words.exampleZh: 这座城市经历了急剧变化。
words.mnemonic: under（在下面）+ go（走）→ 在下面走 = 亲身经历。过去式 underwent，过去分词 undergone。

extraExamples.en: He underwent a major operation.
The house is undergoing repairs.

words.example: Constant criticism undermined his confidence.
words.exampleZh: 不断的批评削弱了他的信心。
words.mnemonic: under（下面）+ mine（挖矿）→ 在下面挖 → 从根基破坏 → 削弱。

extraExamples.en: Rising costs undermine profits.
His lies undermined her trust.
extraExamples.zh: 他的谎言破坏了她的信任。

words.example: We should utilize available resources wisely.
words.exampleZh: 我们应明智地利用可用资源。
words.mnemonic: util（用，同 useful）+ -ize → 利用。名词 utility（效用/公用事业）。

extraExamples.en: How can we best utilize the space?
extraExamples.zh: 我们怎么最好地利用空间？

extraExamples.en: The coast is fully utilized.

words.definition: 有效的，合理的，有根据的
words.example: Your passport must be valid for travel.
words.exampleZh: 你的护照必须有效才能出行。

phrases.zh: 正当理由/有根据的论点

words.mnemonic: val（强壮，同 value 价值）+ -id → 有价值的 → 有效的。反义 invalid。

extraExamples.en: The ticket is valid for three months.
She has a valid point.

words.example: Children are especially vulnerable to the disease.
words.exampleZh: 儿童尤其容易感染这种疾病。
words.mnemonic: vulner（伤口，同 vulnus 拉丁"伤"）+ -able → 容易受伤的。名词 vulnerability。

extraExamples.en: The economy is vulnerable to shocks.
She felt vulnerable without him.

words.example: The idea gained widespread acceptance.
words.exampleZh: 这个想法获得了广泛认可。
words.mnemonic: wide（宽）+ spread（传播）→ 宽范围传播的 → 广泛的。

extraExamples.en: The storm caused widespread damage.
extraExamples.zh: 暴风雨造成大面积破坏。

extraExamples.en: English is a widespread language.
extraExamples.zh: 英语是广泛使用的语言。

words.example: She is a zealous supporter of the cause.
words.exampleZh: 她是这项事业的热心支持者。
words.mnemonic: zeal（热情）+ -ous → 热情的。名词 zealotry（狂热）。

extraExamples.en: He is zealous about environmental issues.
She is zealous in her work.

words.example: He abandoned the plan halfway.
words.exampleZh: 他中途放弃了计划。
words.mnemonic: a-（去）+ bandon（控制，同 ban 禁止）→ 放弃控制 → 抛弃。

extraExamples.en: They had to abandon the car.
Never abandon your dreams.

words.example: Plants absorb water from the soil.
words.exampleZh: 植物从土壤中吸收水分。
words.mnemonic: ab-（离开）+ sorb（吸，同 sponge 海绵）→ 吸过来 → 吸收。形容词 absorbing（引人入胜的）。

extraExamples.en: The material absorbs sound.
She was absorbed in her book.

words.example: The region has abundant natural resources.
words.exampleZh: 该地区自然资源丰富。
words.mnemonic: ab-（加强）+ und（波浪，同 abundant = 波浪漫出来）+ -ant → 漫出来 → 丰富的。名词 abundance。

extraExamples.en: The country has abundant oil.
We have abundant evidence.

words.example: The car accelerated quickly.
words.exampleZh: 汽车迅速加速。
words.mnemonic: ac-（加强）+ celer（快，同 celerity）+ -ate → 使更快 → 加速。名词 acceleration。

extraExamples.en: Inflation accelerated sharply.
The runner accelerated toward the finish.

words.example: She acquired a new skill.
words.exampleZh: 她学会了一项新技能。
words.mnemonic: ac-（去）+ quire（寻求，同 require 需要）→ 去寻求 → 获得。名词 acquisition。

extraExamples.en: He acquired a taste for jazz.
The firm was acquired last year.

words.example: The room has adequate lighting.
words.exampleZh: 房间照明充足。
words.mnemonic: ad-（去）+ equ（相等，同 equal）+ -ate → 与所需相等 → 足够的。反义 inadequate。

extraExamples.en: Is the salary adequate?
The room is adequate for one person.

words.example: You need to adjust the settings.
words.exampleZh: 你需要调整设置。
words.mnemonic: ad-（去）+ just（正确，同 just 正好）→ 使正确 → 调整。名词 adjustment。

extraExamples.en: It took her time to adjust.
Please adjust your seat.

words.example: Many advocate a healthier diet.
words.exampleZh: 许多人提倡更健康的饮食。
words.mnemonic: ad-（去）+ voc（喊，同 voice）+ -ate → 喊出来支持 → 提倡。

extraExamples.en: He advocates reform.
She is a passionate advocate for animals.
extraExamples.zh: 她是动物保护的热心倡导者。

words.example: We may alter the plan.
words.exampleZh: 我们可能会修改计划。
words.mnemonic: alter（其他，同 alternate 交替）→ 变成其他 → 改变。形容词 alternative（可供选择的）。

extraExamples.en: The city has altered beyond recognition.
She altered the dress to fit.

words.example: The annual meeting is in May.
words.exampleZh: 年度会议在五月举行。
words.mnemonic: ann（年，同 anniversary 周年）+ -ual → 每年的。副词 annually。

extraExamples.en: The company holds an annual picnic.
What is your annual salary?

words.example: The design has broad appeal.
words.exampleZh: 这个设计广受欢迎。

phrases.zh: 对某人有吸引力/向某人呼吁

words.mnemonic: ap-（去）+ peal（驱动，同 appeal = 拉）→ 拉着人 → 吸引力；引申为呼吁。

extraExamples.en: The design appeals to young people.
They made an appeal for donations.

words.example: Wear appropriate clothes.
words.exampleZh: 穿合适的衣服。
words.mnemonic: ap-（去）+ propri（自己的，同 proper）+ -ate → 属于自己的 → 合适的。动词 appropriate 意为"挪用/拨出"。

extraExamples.en: Wear shoes appropriate for running.
Please keep your comments appropriate.

words.example: They assembled the machine.
words.exampleZh: 他们组装了这台机器。
words.mnemonic: as-（一起）+ sembl（相同，同 same）→ 聚到一起 → 集合；引申为组装。名词 assembly。

extraExamples.en: The workers assemble cars.
A crowd assembled outside.

words.example: We need to assess the risks.
words.exampleZh: 我们需要评估风险。
words.mnemonic: as-（靠近）+ sess（坐，同 sit）→ 坐到旁边算账 → 评估。名词 assessment。

extraExamples.en: It’s hard to assess the damage.
Teachers assess students’ progress.

words.example: I assume you agree.
words.exampleZh: 我假定你同意。
words.mnemonic: as-（去）+ sume（拿，同 consume 拿过来=消费）→ 拿来当真 → 假定。名词 assumption。

extraExamples.en: Don’t assume anything.
He assumed control last year.

words.example: She attributed success to hard work.
words.exampleZh: 她把成功归因于努力工作。
words.mnemonic: at-（去）+ tribut（给，同 contribute 贡献）→ 把功劳给出去 → 归因于。

extraExamples.en: He attributed his success to luck.
Patience is her best attribute.

words.example: Language is a barrier for some.
words.exampleZh: 语言对有些人是个障碍。
words.mnemonic: barr（栏杆，同 bar 拦杆）+ -ier → 栏杆 → 屏障。

extraExamples.en: Fear is a barrier to success.
The Yangtze is a natural barrier.

words.example: He spoke on my behalf.
words.exampleZh: 他代表我发言。
words.mnemonic: be-（使）+ half（半，原指"代表一半的人"）→ 代表。

extraExamples.en: I thank you on behalf of the team.
He accepted the prize on her behalf.

words.example: The device has advanced capabilities.
words.exampleZh: 该设备有先进的功能。
words.mnemonic: cap（拿，同 capable 能拿住的）+ ability → 能力。

extraExamples.en: The platform has many capabilities.
It’s beyond my capabilities.

words.example: The noise finally ceased.
words.exampleZh: 噪音终于停止了。
words.mnemonic: ceas（停，同 cede 让步）→ 停止。形容词 ceaseless（不停的）。

extraExamples.en: The company ceased trading.
He never ceases to amaze me.

words.example: Our schedules coincide.
words.exampleZh: 我们的日程一致。
words.mnemonic: co-（共同）+ in（进入）+ cide（落下，同 incident 落到一起=事件）→ 一起落到 → 同时发生。名词 coincidence。

extraExamples.en: My birthday coincides with Christmas.
extraExamples.zh: 我生日和圣诞节同一天。

extraExamples.en: Our views coincide.

words.example: The meeting will commence at 9.
words.exampleZh: 会议将在九点开始。
words.mnemonic: com-（一起）+ mence（开始，同 menu 开头）→ 开始。反义 cease。

extraExamples.en: The ceremony commenced at noon.
Construction will commence soon.

words.example: Duty compelled him to act.
words.exampleZh: 责任迫使他行动。
words.mnemonic: com-（加强）+ pel（推，同 propel 推进）→ 用力推 → 强迫。形容词 compelling（令人信服的）。

extraExamples.en: Hunger compelled him to steal.
She felt compelled to speak out.

words.example: The wine complements the meal.
words.exampleZh: 这酒和饭菜相得益彰。
words.mnemonic: com-（一起）+ plet（填满，同 complete）→ 填满 → 补足。注意与 compliment（赞美）拼写发音都相近，别混。

extraExamples.en: The flowers complement the room.
extraExamples.zh: 鲜花点缀得房间更漂亮。

extraExamples.en: The couple complement each other.

words.example: He conceded the point.
words.exampleZh: 他承认了这一点。
words.mnemonic: con-（一起）+ cede（让步，同 cede 割让）→ 一起让步 → 承认。名词 concession。

extraExamples.en: He conceded defeat before the count ended.
extraExamples.zh: 计票未结束他就认输了。

extraExamples.en: She conceded that she was wrong.

words.example: Please confine the discussion to the topic.
words.exampleZh: 请把讨论限制在主题内。
words.mnemonic: con-（加强）+ fine（边界，同 finish）→ 画边界 → 限制。名词 confinement。

extraExamples.en: Please confine your remarks to the issue.
She was confined to a wheelchair.

words.example: We must confront the problem.
words.exampleZh: 我们必须正视这个问题。
words.mnemonic: con-（一起）+ front（前面）→ 一起上前 → 面对。名词 confrontation。

extraExamples.en: We must confront our fears.
He confronted his boss about the pay.

words.example: They reached a consensus.
words.exampleZh: 他们达成了共识。
words.mnemonic: con-（共同）+ sens（感觉，同 sense）+ -us → 共同感觉 → 共识。

extraExamples.en: There is broad consensus on this.
extraExamples.zh: 这一点上大家广泛共识。

extraExamples.en: No consensus was reached.

words.example: Twelve months constitute a year.
words.exampleZh: 十二个月构成一年。
words.mnemonic: con-（一起）+ stitute（站立，同 stand）→ 站到一起 → 组成。名词 constitution（宪法/构成）。

extraExamples.en: Women constitute half the population.
This constitutes an emergency.

words.example: Budget constrains our choices.
words.exampleZh: 预算限制了我们的选择。
words.mnemonic: con-（一起）+ strain（拉紧）→ 拉紧 → 约束。名词 constraint。

extraExamples.en: Budget constraints force cuts.
She felt constrained by rules.

words.example: She studies contemporary art.
words.exampleZh: 她研究当代艺术。
words.mnemonic: con-（共同）+ tempor（时间，同 tempo 节奏）+ -ary → 同时代的 → 当代的。

extraExamples.en: He was contemporary with Shakespeare.
The exhibit shows contemporary design.

words.example: The data contradicts his claim.
words.exampleZh: 数据与他的说法矛盾。
words.mnemonic: contra-（反）+ dict（说，同 dictionary 词典=说的话）→ 反着说 → 反驳。名词 contradiction。

extraExamples.en: His actions contradict his words.
The reports contradict each other.

words.example: The contrast is striking.
words.exampleZh: 对比十分鲜明。
words.mnemonic: contra-（反）+ st（站，同 stand）→ 反着站 → 对比。

extraExamples.en: By contrast, sales fell.
Contrast this with last year.

words.example: Timing is crucial.
words.exampleZh: 时机至关重要。
words.mnemonic: cruc（十字，同 cross）+ -ial → 在十字路口 → 关键的。

extraExamples.en: This is a crucial moment.
Sleep is crucial to health.

words.example: The event culminated in a celebration.
words.exampleZh: 活动以庆祝达到高潮。
words.mnemonic: culmin（顶点，同 column 柱顶）+ -ate → 到顶点。

extraExamples.en: Years of work culminated in the book.
extraExamples.zh: 多年工作最终写成此书。

extraExamples.en: The festival culminated with fireworks.

words.example: The soil is deficient in iron.
words.exampleZh: 土壤缺铁。
words.mnemonic: de-（离开）+ fic（做）+ -ient → 没做到位 → 不足的。名词 deficiency。

extraExamples.en: His diet is deficient in vitamins.
We found the evidence deficient.

words.example: Let me demonstrate how it works.
words.exampleZh: 让我演示它的工作原理。
words.mnemonic: de-（完全）+ monstr（显示，同 monster 原指"神迹")+ -ate → 完全显示 → 演示。名词 demonstration。

extraExamples.en: Let me demonstrate.
The data demonstrates a clear trend.

words.example: The painting depicts a village.
words.exampleZh: 这幅画描绘了一个村庄。
words.mnemonic: de-（完全）+ pict（画，同 picture）→ 完全画出来 → 描绘。名词 depiction。

extraExamples.en: The film depicts life in prison.
extraExamples.zh: 这部电影描绘狱中生活。

extraExamples.en: The ad depicts a happy family.

words.example: This area is designated for parking.
words.exampleZh: 该区域被指定为停车区。
words.mnemonic: de-（出）+ sign（标记）+ -ate → 标出来 → 指定。

extraExamples.en: This floor is designated for staff.
She was designated as team leader.

words.example: Discard the old files.
words.exampleZh: 丢弃旧文件。
words.mnemonic: dis-（分开）+ card（牌，原指打牌时丢牌）→ 丢牌 → 丢弃。

extraExamples.en: Discard empty bottles.
He discarded his coat.

words.example: We could discern a pattern.
words.exampleZh: 我们能看出一种模式。
words.mnemonic: dis-（分开）+ cern（区分，同 concern 区分出=关心）→ 分出来 → 辨别。

extraExamples.en: Can you discern the meaning?
We discerned a change in his mood.
extraExamples.zh: 我们察觉到他情绪变化。

words.example: Machines displaced many workers.
words.exampleZh: 机器取代了许多工人。
words.mnemonic: dis-（离开）+ place（位置）→ 离开位置 → 取代/使流离。名词 displacement。

extraExamples.en: The war displaced thousands.
extraExamples.zh: 战争使成千上万人流离失所。

extraExamples.en: Coal has been displaced by gas.

words.example: The fog dissipated by noon.
words.exampleZh: 雾气在中午前消散了。
words.mnemonic: dis-（分开）+ sip（扔，同 separate）+ -ate → 散开 → 消散。

extraExamples.en: Her anger slowly dissipated.
The sun dissipated the mist.

words.example: Distinguish between fact and opinion.
words.exampleZh: 区分事实与观点。
words.mnemonic: di-（分开）+ stingu（刺，同 sting）+ -ish → 刺出标记 → 区分。形容词 distinctive（独特的）。

extraExamples.en: Can you distinguish the twins?
extraExamples.zh: 你能分清这对双胞胎吗？

extraExamples.en: She distinguished herself in math.

words.example: The image is embedded in the text.
words.exampleZh: 图片嵌入在文本中。
words.mnemonic: em-（进入）+ bed（床）→ 放进床里 → 嵌入。

extraExamples.en: The bullet was embedded in his arm.
Cultural values are embedded in language.
extraExamples.zh: 文化价值观深植于语言中。

words.example: She is an eminent scientist.
words.exampleZh: 她是位杰出的科学家。
words.mnemonic: e-（出）+ min（突出，同 prominent）+ -ent → 突出来的 → 杰出的。注意与 imminent（即将发生的）区分。

extraExamples.en: He is an eminent lawyer.
She is eminent in the field.

words.example: The theory is based on empirical data.
words.exampleZh: 该理论基于实证数据。
words.mnemonic: em-（在里面）+ pir（尝试，同 experiment 试验）+ -ical → 靠尝试得出的 → 实证的。

extraExamples.en: There is no empirical proof.
Empirical studies support the theory.

words.example: The committee endorsed the plan.
words.exampleZh: 委员会赞同该计划。
words.mnemonic: en-（进入）+ dors（背，同 dorsal 背部）→ 背书写字 → 在背面签字 → 赞同。

extraExamples.en: The celebrity endorsed the new phone.
extraExamples.zh: 这位明星为新手机代言。

extraExamples.en: I fully endorse her decision.

words.example: The job entails long hours.
words.exampleZh: 这份工作需要长时间。
words.mnemonic: en-（进入）+ tail（切割，同 tailor 裁缝切割）→ 牵扯进去 → 需要、牵涉。

extraExamples.en: The project entails many risks.
extraExamples.zh: 这个项目涉及很多风险。

extraExamples.en: The plan entails cutting costs.

words.example: She runs a successful enterprise.
words.exampleZh: 她经营一家成功的企业。
words.mnemonic: enter（进入）+ prise（握，同 prize 抓）→ 掌握进去 → 事业、企业。形容词 enterprising（有事业心的）。

extraExamples.en: The enterprise employs 500 people.
It was a bold enterprise.

words.example: We envisage a bright future.
words.exampleZh: 我们设想一个光明的未来。
words.mnemonic: en-（使）+ vis（看，同 vision 视觉）+ -age → 使看到 → 设想。

extraExamples.en: I don’t envisage any problems.
He envisaged himself as a doctor.

words.example: They demand equitable treatment.
words.exampleZh: 他们要求公平对待。
words.mnemonic: equit（相等，同 equal）+ -able → 能相等的 → 公平的。名词 equity（公平/股权）。

extraExamples.en: We need an equitable system.
The split was equitable.

words.example: He exerted great influence.
words.exampleZh: 他施加了巨大影响。
words.mnemonic: ex-（出）+ ert（锻炼，同 exercise 练习）→ 用出来 → 施加。名词 exertion。

extraExamples.en: She exerted all her strength.
He exerted pressure on the bank.

words.example: We must expedite the process.
words.exampleZh: 我们必须加快进程。
words.mnemonic: ex-（出）+ ped（脚，同 pedal 踏板）+ -ite → 抬脚走 → 加快。反义 impede。

extraExamples.en: Please expedite the order.
We need to expedite the application.
